propositions: Test-only real-time windows in review-bot bootstrap, lock-retry, shutdown, and autodeploy cases consume multi-second wall-clock costs per cell without affecting production logic.
Production timeout, retry, drain, and health budgets must remain contractually unchanged while test execution time is optimized through clock injection and parameter scaling.

Shortening test windows from baseline median 56.22s to 29.31s (47.9% reduction) while preserving subprocess, lock, process-group, and health boundary coverage requires exact-defect mutation verification and reproducible RED-to-GREEN evidence.
Clock injection and test-owned parameter scaling must not affect real boundary execution, attempt counts, logical backoff schedules, terminal states, or observability assertions.
